modules.base: No base plan and no factor: this is a CONSTRUCTION contact, not an arm of the locked v2.0 default plan. What is registered is the contact form -- arm construction-advantage-text, program phase-stage3-advantage-v2, the two pinned templates, the stage3-advantage-statement-v2 response format, evidence_source none and scorers ['cost'] -- on the same frozen core and the same resident SLURP geometry cell PLAN and cell ROLL-1 fly.
what_the_contact_sees: the Perception candidate list, in the order the Perception node proposed it (first-occurrence distinct ids, with the raw count)
ANSWER A (best) and ANSWER B (worst): the two custodied ROLL-1 Solver samples of this row's N=5 group, rendered into the instruction only, never into a receipt

the DELIVERED answer with the Reviewer's verdict labels (re-derived from the sealed Reviewer response by rails.review_primitives.parse_review_primitive) and the Planner's route (action labels, revision count, delivery kind)
the row's own construction gold, carried by construction_targets -- the same D2 field set construction-proposer-text carries, unchanged by S3-4s

block_form.shape: one to three four-line blocks (MAX_ADVANTAGE_BLOCKS = 3; a fourth and later block is RETAINED and marked illegal, never silently dropped)
lines: DELTA-KIND: <intent-boundary | slot-contract | exemplar-note | perception-hint | reviewer-criterion | planner-rule>
TARGET: <the scenario_action or slot type this statement is about>
block_form.vocabulary_source: rails.stage3_advantage.LEGAL_DELTA_NODES and LEGAL_DELTA_KINDS_V2 -- the v2 kinds are v1's three plus one per newly addressable node (spec section S3-4s). The committed template configs/probes/slurp_stage3_advantage_v2.txt states the same six.
block_form.illegal_blocks: RETAINED and marked, never dropped by the parser and never repaired; S3-5's curation drops them, and this cell counts them by the parser's own reason strings: 'response text is not a string', 'no NODE/DELTA-KIND/TARGET/STATEMENT block was found', 'N blocks exceed the 3-block form', 'missing keys: ...', 'illegal node: ...', 'illegal delta-kind: ...', 'empty target', 'empty statement', 'statement exceeds 40 words (M)', 'block i is past the 3-block form'.

s3_3_facts.note: Read model-free from S3-3's own pairs.json trajectory block (saea-stage3-rollout-pairs-v2) and its summary; ids, labels, counts and hashes only. 194 / 225 is the headroom this contact is being asked about: on 31 rows the gold intent was never among the Perception candidates at all, so no Solver choice could have recovered it and the responsible node is Perception by construction. known_gap_delivered_below_best.what: pairs.json's per-row delivered_below_best flag is VACUOUS in this seal and must not be read as a rate.
known_gap_delivered_below_best.why: The sealed ROLL-1 run carries the delivered answer's own official score under the scorer id slurp-slu-official-train (the campaign's one complete official score at finalize), while S3-3 scored the five custodied Solver samples offline under slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train. delivered_below_best compares the delivered score to the best SAMPLE score, so it compares two different scorer ids -- for rows where the delivered score is absent under the projected-v3 id the flag falls back to its own absent/False reading rather than a measurement.
known_gap_delivered_below_best.consequence: DIAGNOSTICS ONLY. The field is rendered into no instruction, feeds no decision rule and appears in no verdict table. The best/worst pair itself is unaffected: both sides of it are sample scores under the SAME projected-v3 id, which is what the advantage contact is shown. Closing the gap means re-scoring the delivered path under the projected-v3 id in a separate model-free act; this package does not attempt it.

blocking_defect_before_the_flip.what: core.flight.cli check REFUSES all four cells today, so the readiness flip would refuse too (scripts/flights/repin_cell.py runs check and asserts the runtime-derived hashes agree). This must be repaired before root mints the decision receipt.
blocking_defect_before_the_flip.the_refusal: CoreError: task_instruction_template requires task_instruction_fill naming a registered instruction fill -- raised from rails.adapters.slurp_runtime.build_runtime_adapter line 203, which computes instruction = resolve_active_task_instruction(...) or resolve_task_instruction(...).
blocking_defect_before_the_flip.why: configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-advantage-baseline-v1.json declares task_instruction_template 'probes/slurp_stage3_advantage_system_v2.txt' with task_instruction_fill null. core.instructions.resolve_task_instruction accepts exactly two spellings: a LITERAL task_instruction, or a template PLUS a registered fill PLUS a single {tool_schemas} placeholder in the template. The system v2 probe is a static system message with no placeholder and the fragment names no fill, so neither spelling is satisfied and the refusal is unconditional. resolve_active_task_instruction returns None first (no literal and no task_instruction_template_active), which is why the 'or' falls through to the refusing resolver rather than to the adapter's own text.
blocking_defect_before_the_flip.provenance: PRE-EXISTING in the committed arm registration at study commit c2754ff1 -- git show c2754ff1:configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-advantage-baseline-v1.json shows the same two keys. The ADV-1 registration agent of 2026-09-23 did not modify that file; the smoke baseline inherits the keys deliberately, because the smoke must fly the arm's form key for key and a smoke that proved a DIFFERENT system message would prove nothing.
the_two_supported_repairs: (a) LITERAL: replace task_instruction_template / task_instruction_fill with a literal task_instruction carrying the system v2 probe's exact text, and keep the probe relpath and sha256 beside it as provenance. Byte-identical wire text to what the registration intended; no code change; the probe stays committed and pinned in configs/probes/manifest.json but stops being the thing that is read.

(b) FILL: register an instruction fill in core.base.INSTRUCTION_FILLS, add the single {tool_schemas} placeholder to the system v2 probe, re-pin the probe in configs/probes/manifest.json, and name the fill in task_instruction_fill. Keeps the probe as the read artifact but changes committed probe bytes and adds code.
blocking_defect_before_the_flip.not_repaired_here: Choosing between (a) and (b) decides what the frozen core sees as its system message and whether committed probe bytes move; that is a registration decision for root, not a mechanical repair, and the registering agent's mandate is this package. Both fragments are left byte-consistent with each other so that whichever repair root applies can be applied to both in one edit. Applying it re-composes both config hashes, so the re-pin cycle rewrites every document that quotes them -- which is what the flip does anyway.

fit.mode: registration reserve -- NO fit mechanism is configured for this cell today
fit.arithmetic: 675 = 225 x 1 x (0 speech packets + 3 endpoints); 12 = 4 x 1 x (0 + 3)
fit.what_is_configured: configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-advantage-baseline-v1.json declares NEITHER native_contact_fit (that path belongs to a native_episode cell, and this cell is a one-phase phase program) NOR live_phase_fit with whole_roster_wave_barrier (the pair core.preparation_fit.validate_live_phase_fit_config requires). No fit gate is therefore built at dispatch and the FIT run ids are expected to be charged ZERO. They are registered all the same so that, if any endpoint spend ever lands under this cell's fit identity, it lands against a row that was written before the result was read.
fit.if_root_ever_configures_live_fit: core.preparation_fit.build_live_phase_fit_gate requires contact_cap to EQUAL len(phases) x (1 + 3 x rows) exactly -- 1 x (1 + 3 x 225) = 676 for the arm and 1 x (1 + 3 x 4) = 13 for the smoke, each ONE MORE than the ceiling registered here (675 / 12) because that formula charges one extra whole-roster barrier contact per phase. Registering a live_phase_fit block therefore requires re-registering the fit ceiling first; this package does not attempt it and nothing here authorises it.
fit.coordinate_fit: must NOT be run; there is no fit identity for it to charge

decision_rule.rule: STRUCTURAL ONLY. No effectiveness claim is read from this cell -- the effect of the curated deltas is read at CELL-1, against the plan's own null. Acceptance here is: (1) PARSE RATE -- the fraction of contacts whose response yields at least one LEGAL block under rails.stage3_advantage.parse_advantage_statements_v2, reported with its denominator; (2) NODE DISTRIBUTION -- the count of legal blocks per NODE value (perception / solver / reviewer / planner), reported as a table, so a contact form that can only ever blame one node is visible before 225 rows are spent; (3) ILLEGAL-BLOCK COUNT -- blocks retained but marked illegal, counted by the parser's own reason strings (illegal node, illegal delta-kind, missing keys, empty target, empty statement, statement exceeds 40 words, past the 3-block form, no block found, non-string response), never dropped and never silently repaired; (4) BLOCKS PER ROW -- the one-to-three distribution; (5) a clean seal with row accounting in = out.
decision_rule.no_gate_number: No threshold is pre-registered on any of the five, because this cell carries no admission verdict: a low parse rate or a degenerate node distribution is a FORM defect that stops the arm and is root-caused, not a measured result. The smoke's own acceptance is the same five items on 4 rows; a failed smoke stops ADV-1 and the arm does not open.
